facts.label: Orações com that e which
facts.sub: Use that ou which para coisas: The bag that I lost has my laptop. Como objeto, that pode sumir: The bag I lost. Não repita o it e não use who ou what.

facts.label: That para coisas
facts.sub: Use that para ligar uma coisa à descrição: The bag that I lost is blue. That é o mais comum na fala. Depois de that, siga com o sujeito ou o verbo, sem repetir o it.

facts.label: Which
facts.sub: Which também serve para coisas e soa um pouco mais formal: The box which holds lost things. Não use who para coisas, e não use what no lugar de that.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We use that or which for things.
We say “The bag that it is blue”.
items.why: We say The bag that is blue.

items.s: “The bag I lost” is correct without that.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: We use that or which for things. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “The bag that it is blue”. → Falso (We say The bag that is blue.)
“The bag I lost” is correct without that. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A train station · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy Monday evening at a train station in Austin. Tom walks along the platform with a worried face. His friend Eli is waiting near a coffee stand. Tom has no bag, and his hands are empty. Eli sees him and waves. Tom starts to explain what happened.

“Tom, you look worried. Is it the bag that you lost?” says Eli. “Yes! The bag that I lost has my laptop and my keys.” says Tom. “Did you ask at the desk? The man there has a box which holds lost things.” says Eli.
